text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED #eng-oncall — high GPU pool saturation detected in us-west-1 (affected: inference-pool-3). Ops: 2109876543. Severity: P2.

maria: oncall here, seeing a spike in 5xxs and queued requests. linking traces.

josh: noted, hitting this while running a large batch of customer retries. queue depth up to ~18k.

samir: adding relevant logs to the thread: 
```
kubectl get hpa -n inference
NAME           REFERENCE             TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-hpa  Deployment/inference  78%/80%   10        30        14         3h
```

leah: infra metrics show GPU utilization 100% for pool inference-pool-3 since 2109876540 (+20s). OOMs? none reported.

josh: stack traces show model load latency increasing from 200ms -> 7s during scale-up. Warmup appears to be the bottleneck.

infra-bot: autoscaler events: 
- 2109876550 scale up from 10 -> 12 (reason: cpu/mem target)
- 2109876576 scale up from 12 -> 14 (reason: custom queue depth policy)
Cooldown remaining: 120s

maria: hypothesis 1 — warmup latency on new nodes is delaying readiness, HPA thinks pods are ready (kubelet ready) but model serving process not accepting connections until warmup finishes.

samir: hypothesis 2 — a recent model-pack change increased disk I/O during model load (larger quant file). That together with driver init after recent node image update slows total node readiness.

leah: customer-impact check: voice of customer flag shows 2 high-priority customers seeing timeouts and a 25% request failure rate across 1.2M requests in last 30m. Notifying CS.

maria: mitigation attempt 1 — switching routing policy to fallback-model-1 (smaller quantized) for heavy customers to reduce per-request load. Doing now: `POST /route/update` with `prefer_fallback=true`

josh: applied routing change at 2109876588. Confirmed traffic shifted ~30% to fallback. 5xxs reduced slightly.

maria: mitigation attempt 2 — temporarily lower HPA target from 80% -> 65% to trigger more proactive scaling. Doing via infra runbook.

infra-bot: HPA update applied at 2109876595, new target 65%. Next evaluate in 45s.

samir: I pulled kubelet logs from one of the warmup-slow nodes — log snippet: 
```
[2109876560] model_server: starting warmup for model v3
[2109876568] model_server: loading weights (I/O)
[2109876576] tcmalloc: large allocation, pausing background threads
[2109876586] model_server: warmup complete, accepting requests
```

leah: warmup window ~26s in that trace; other nodes show 45-70s. median increased since last deploy.

maria: short-term additional mitigation — mark inference-pool-3 as drainable and spin up prewarmed pool in us-west-1 with nodes that have cached models. Requesting Dedicated team to seed prewarmed nodes.

oncall-shadow: seeding prewarmed nodes request sent to infra-ops at 2109876608 (ticket #INC-8342). ETA approx 6m.

josh: note: cooldown prevented HPA from adding more replicas fast enough; we saw 2 scale events but pods take >40s to become usable, queue piles up. Need to look at HPA cooldown and custom queue policy interaction.

maria: agreed — HPA cooldown and readiness probe semantics probably allowed pods to be considered available too early. Add to RCA list: readinessProbe vs application readiness, HPA cooldown config, model load I/O regression, node image change.

leah: mitigation status update: prewarmed pool started at 2109876636, traffic redirected — successful, queue depth falling. GPU utilization for pool-3 now 85% and trending down.

samir: capturing artifacts for RCA: kubelet logs, model server warmup traces, recent model pack manifest, node image hash, autoscaler event log, routing changes, customer error samples.

maria: brief handoff for next oncall (leah takes it): summary -> P2 saturation due to slow model warmup on scale-up + HPA cooldown/threshold settings; mitigations -> routing to fallback, lower HPA target, prewarmed pool seeding, customer notifications. Items to collect -> logs above + driver/kernel init times across nodes.

leah: oncall takeover at 2109876665. I will own the RCA tracking doc and coordinate with infra and runtime teams. Leaving a pinned checklist in #eng-oncall.

maria: final quick notes: assign followups — Samir (model pack I/O regression), Josh (HPA cooldown config change proposal), Leah (driver/node image validation), Maria (customer postmortem). ETA for formal RCA doc: EOD +1. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident closure candidate noted at 2109876699 — system metrics normalized and queue depth under threshold for 10m. Pending RCA write-up.
